units.text: INT. FLOODED SIGNAL BUNKER - NIGHT
A concrete cell below a ruined rail yard.
Knee-deep black water.
Shells land overhead in a steady rhythm; dust sifts from the ceiling with each one.
SERGEANT IMRE VÁRHEGYI (30s, radio operator, face smeared with soot, headset over a bandaged ear) crouches at a field set balanced on a stack of ammunition crates.
He holds the handset in both fists.
Wolf Three, this is Hearth. Say again your last.
units.name: IMRE

units.text: Static.
A shell lands.
A pipe bursts somewhere and a thin stream of water begins to fall on the radio.
He shields it with his body.
Hearth, Wolf Three. Grid is compromised. Repeat, grid is compromised. Fall back to the--
units.name: COMMANDER

units.text: The voice breaks into crackling.
Wolf Three, you are cutting out. Say again fall back to where?
units.name: IMRE

units.text: Static.
Another impact, closer.
A chunk of ceiling drops into the water beside him.
He does not flinch; he wipes the handset on his sleeve.
Wolf Three, Hearth. Do you copy? Wolf Three.
units.name: IMRE

units.text: --the old chapel. East of the water tower. Bring the set if you can carry it.
units.name: COMMANDER

units.text: The set weighs forty kilos, sir.
units.name: IMRE

units.text: Then leave it, Sergeant. Leave it and run.
units.name: COMMANDER

units.text: He looks at the radio.
At the water rising around his thighs.
At the iron ladder bolted to the wall, three rungs of it underwater.
Sir, if I leave it, the battalion has no voice.
units.name: IMRE

units.text: The battalion has no battalion, Imre. Go.
units.name: COMMANDER

units.text: A long beat.
He sets the handset down on the crate, carefully, like something sleeping.
Reaches under the set and unclips the battery.
Pulls the crystal.
Pockets both.
Tell it to the next man.
units.name: IMRE

units.text: He wades to the ladder.
Behind him the handset crackles to itself.
Hearth? Hearth, are you there?
units.name: COMMANDER

units.text: Imre stops on the ladder with one boot on the lowest dry rung.
He climbs back down.
Picks up the handset.
Wolf Three, Hearth. I am here.
units.name: IMRE

units.text: A shell lands.
The lamp dies.
Darkness, and the sound of rushing water.
